brief:
American pro-Palestinian activist Fergie Chambers has been released in Spain on conditional terms while fighting extradition to the United States, Middle East Eye reported. The US acknowledged translation errors in court proceedings related to his case. Chambers expressed relief at his release, saying he was "happy to breathe fresh air" following his time in prison.

The activist remains engaged in legal proceedings to resist extradition as the US pursues the matter against him.

title: US admits court translation errors in Fergie Chambers case
